fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short name of the rule. Shown when a permission is explained.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Only active rules are applied. An inactive rule does not govern its document type.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: Document type whose records this rule narrows. Child tables, single and virtual document types and the document types of the permission system are not accepted.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Role the rule applies to. A user is covered when they hold this role.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Which records the rule selects relative to the user: own (the user's records), team (the user and everyone reporting to them through Employee.reports_to), department (the user's department and its sub-departments), company (the user's company) or all (every record).

fields.label: Match Field
fields.description: Field of the document type that ties a record to a user, employee, department or company, for example employee or owner. Required unless the scope is all. Use name when the record itself is the employee, department or company.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Order in which rules are listed when a permission is explained. Lower numbers come first. It never changes the decision.

fields.label: Allow Read
fields.description: The rule covers reading, listing, printing, emailing, exporting, reporting and sharing.

fields.label: Allow Write
fields.description: The rule covers changing a saved record.

fields.label: Allow Create
fields.description: The rule covers creating and amending a record. The new values must satisfy the rule.

fields.label: Allow Delete
fields.description: The rule covers deleting a record.

fields.label: Allow Submit
fields.description: The rule covers submitting a record.

fields.label: Allow Cancel
fields.description: The rule covers cancelling a submitted record.

fields.label: Filters
fields.description: Extra conditions as a JSON list of [field, operator, value] rows. All rows must hold. Operators: =, !=, in, not in. A value may be a constant or one of $user, $user.employee, $user.department, $user.company.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Why this rule exists. Free text for administrators and assistants.
